title: OrcaResolverBridgeRequest
description: Orca Design Mode element capture request to the Hermes State Engine Resolver (FRS-005). Contract IDD-016 v1.0.0. All field names are snake_case. Enum values are snake_case.

schema_version.description: Bridge contract version. Major version changes are breaking. The resolver MUST reject unknown versions with UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION.

request_id.description: UUIDv4 generated by the caller. Idempotency key. The resolver caches the response for this id for 60s and replays it on retry without re-executing any action.

captured_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of the capture, from the capturing CDP session clock.

timeout_ms.description: Caller-side budget for resolution plus optional action execution. The resolver returns RESOLVER_TIMEOUT when this budget is exceeded.

page.description: Page context the element was captured from. The resolver MUST operate on this exact target.

target_id.description: CDP Target.targetId of the tab that holds the element. backendDOMNodeId is only meaningful within this target.

frame_id.description: CDP Page.frameId of the frame that owns the element. Omit for the main frame.

element.description: The captured element. Capture via CDP from the click target, including elements rendered inside Radix portals.

backend_dom_node_id.description: CDP DOM backendNodeId of the clicked element. Exact handle for the confidence 1.0 fast path.

outer_html.description: outerHTML of the element subtree (CDP DOM.getOuterHTML). Truncate at the last complete tag beyond 200000 chars and set truncated=true.

tag.description: Lowercase tag name of the element, e.g. button, input, div.

attributes.description: Element attributes as string key-value pairs. Include id, name, class, type, placeholder, aria-label, aria-describedby, role, href, title, data-testid when present. Omit absent attributes.

ancestor_path.description: Ancestor chain ordered nearest-ancestor-first, up to 8 entries, ending at html. Each step carries the 1-based index among same-tag siblings.

structural_hash.description: SHA-256 hex over the canonical structural string. Canonical string = ancestor_path segments nearest-first, then the element itself, joined by '|'. Each segment = tag:index:id (id empty when absent). Example: div:3:|div:1:asset-form|html:1:|button:1:save-btn

truncated.description: True when outer_html was truncated at the 200000 char cap.

computed_styles.description: Exact subset of CDP CSS.getComputedStyle output. Keys are kebab-case exactly as CDP returns them. Values are the raw strings.

geometry.description: Element bounding box from CDP DOM.getBoxModel or getContentQuads, collapsed to the first quad.

coordinate_space.description: Coordinates are CSS pixels relative to the viewport origin.

portal.description: Portal rendering context. Elements inside Radix portals live under a portal root outside the main React tree. They still have valid backendDOMNodeIds and MUST be captured.

in_portal.description: True when the element's nearest portal ancestor exists (e.g. under div[data-radix-portal] or document.body > div portal root).

portal_root_hint.description: Selector hint for the portal root container, when in_portal is true.

screenshot.description: Element screenshot reference. Use data_uri for element clips up to 4MB encoded. Use blob_ref beyond that.

storage.description: data_uri embeds the image inline. blob_ref references a blob the caller holds.

data_uri.description: Data URI of the element clip. Required when storage=data_uri. Pattern: data:image/png;base64,... or data:image/jpeg;base64,...

blob_id.description: Caller-scoped blob identifier. Required when storage=blob_ref.

blob_url.description: Optional URL the resolver can use to fetch the blob when it shares the caller's origin.

blob_expires_at.description: When the blob reference stops being valid.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex of the raw image bytes. Enables integrity checks and dedupe.

action.description: Optional intended operation. When present, the resolver resolves the element and the Action Engine executes the operation, then the Verification Engine confirms via state-diff. When absent, the response carries resolution and action_hints only.

value.description: Value for fill, type, or select. Omit for click and hover.

submit.description: For type: press Enter after typing.

app.description: Application identifier, e.g. salestrekker. Used to scope known-bug registry consultation.

hints.description: Free-form caller hints. Reserved. The resolver MUST NOT treat hints as authoritative.
